introduction.text: A. De Gasparis found Ausonia at Naples in 1861. Its surface reflects about 13% of the sunlight that reaches it.

shape.title: DAMIT shape model
shape.summary: Fitted to light curves and resolved telescope images, so large hollows can show. The spin angle shown is arbitrary.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 46.5 km sphere, sharing the size uncertainty. Colors mix the overall shape with local relief.

zimpol.title: ZIMPOL deconvolved imaging
zimpol.summary: Telescope images of the lit surface, placed by the asteroid’s own measured spin. Grey is photographed light, not colour.
